{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_alu_fast_add #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] x, y,
    input wire cin,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] z
);
    localparam GROUPS = (WIDTH+3)/4;
    localparam LEVELS = (GROUPS > 1) ? $clog2(GROUPS) : 0;
    wire [4*GROUPS-1:0] p, g;
    wire [GROUPS-1:0] gp [0:LEVELS];
    wire [GROUPS-1:0] gg [0:LEVELS];
    wire [GROUPS:0] carry;
    assign carry[0] = cin;
    genvar i, j, k;
    generate
        for (i=0; i<4*GROUPS; i=i+1) begin: bit_pg
            if (i < WIDTH) begin: real_bit
                assign p[i] = x[i] ^ y[i];
                assign g[i] = x[i] & y[i];
            end else begin: padding
                assign p[i] = 1'b1;
                assign g[i] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        for (j=0; j<GROUPS; j=j+1) begin: blocks
            wire [3:0] bp, bg;
            wire [3:0] bc;
            assign bp = p[4*j +: 4];
            assign bg = g[4*j +: 4];
            assign gp[0][j] = &bp;
            assign gg[0][j] = bg[3] | (bp[3]&bg[2]) |
                (bp[3]&bp[2]&bg[1]) |
                (bp[3]&bp[2]&bp[1]&bg[0]);
            assign carry[j+1] = gg[LEVELS][j] |
                (gp[LEVELS][j] & cin);
            assign bc[0] = carry[j];
            assign bc[1] = bg[0] | (bp[0]&carry[j]);
            assign bc[2] = bg[1] | (bp[1]&bg[0]) |
                (bp[1]&bp[0]&carry[j]);
            assign bc[3] = bg[2] | (bp[2]&bg[1]) |
                (bp[2]&bp[1]&bg[0]) |
                (bp[2]&bp[1]&bp[0]&carry[j]);
            for (k=0; k<4; k=k+1) begin: sum_bits
                if (4*j+k < WIDTH) begin: real_sum
                    assign z[4*j+k] = bp[k] ^ bc[k];
                end
            end
        end
        for (i=0; i<LEVELS; i=i+1) begin: prefix_level
            for (j=0; j<GROUPS; j=j+1) begin: prefix_node
                if (j >= (1<<i)) begin: combine
                    assign gp[i+1][j] = gp[i][j] & gp[i][j-(1<<i)];
                    assign gg[i+1][j] = gg[i][j] |
                        (gp[i][j] & gg[i][j-(1<<i)]);
                end else begin: pass_through
                    assign gp[i+1][j] = gp[i][j];
                    assign gg[i+1][j] = gg[i][j];
                end
            end
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] add_result, sub_ab, sub_ba;
    wire [6:0] select_op;
    pw_alu_fast_add #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) add_unit (
        .x(a), .y(b), .cin(1'b0), .z(add_result)
    );
    pw_alu_fast_add #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) sub_ab_unit (
        .x(a), .y(~b), .cin(1'b1), .z(sub_ab)
    );
    pw_alu_fast_add #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) sub_ba_unit (
        .x(b), .y(~a), .cin(1'b1), .z(sub_ba)
    );
    assign select_op[0] = (Oper == 3'b000);
    assign select_op[1] = (Oper == 3'b001);
    assign select_op[2] = (Oper == 3'b010);
    assign select_op[3] = (Oper == 3'b011);
    assign select_op[4] = (Oper == 3'b100);
    assign select_op[5] = (Oper == 3'b101);
    assign select_op[6] = (Oper == 3'b110);
    always @* begin
        sum = ({WIDTH{select_op[0]}} & add_result) |
              ({WIDTH{select_op[1]}} & sub_ab) |
              ({WIDTH{select_op[2]}} & sub_ba) |
              ({WIDTH{select_op[3]}} & (a | b)) |
              ({WIDTH{select_op[4]}} & (a & b)) |
              ({WIDTH{select_op[5]}} & (a ^ b)) |
              ({WIDTH{select_op[6]}} & (a ~^ b));
    end
endmodule

module pw_pipeline_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 32,
    parameter STAGES = 2
)(
    input wire clk, rst,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    input wire in_valid,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] result,
    output wire out_valid
);
    reg [WIDTH-1:0] operand_a, operand_b;
    reg [2:0] opcode;
    reg input_valid;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] alu_result;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] stage_data [0:STAGES-2];
    wire stage_valid [0:STAGES-2];

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            operand_a <= 0;
            operand_b <= 0;
            opcode <= 0;
            input_valid <= 0;
        end else begin
            operand_a <= a;
            operand_b <= b;
            opcode <= Oper;
            input_valid <= in_valid;
        end
    end

    pw_alu #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) alu (
        .a(operand_a), .b(operand_b), .Oper(opcode), .sum(alu_result)
    );

    genvar index;
    generate
        for (index=0; index<STAGES-1; index=index+1) begin: output_pipeline
            reg [WIDTH-1:0] data_reg;
            reg valid_reg;
            wire [WIDTH-1:0] next_data;
            wire next_valid;
            if (index == 0) begin: first_stage
                assign next_data = alu_result;
                assign next_valid = input_valid;
            end else begin: following_stage
                assign next_data = stage_data[index-1];
                assign next_valid = stage_valid[index-1];
            end
            always @(posedge clk) begin
                if (rst) begin
                    data_reg <= 0;
                    valid_reg <= 0;
                end else begin
                    data_reg <= next_data;
                    valid_reg <= next_valid;
                end
            end
            assign stage_data[index] = data_reg;
            assign stage_valid[index] = valid_reg;
        end
    endgenerate
    assign result = stage_data[STAGES-2];
    assign out_valid = stage_valid[STAGES-2];
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The likely setup bottleneck is the operand-register to output-register arithmetic path: carry propagation through a 16-bit addition or subtraction, followed by operation selection and synchronous-reset gating.",
  "rewrite": "Keep the complete register structure and reset behavior unchanged. Compute the three arithmetic operations independently using four-bit carry-lookahead blocks and a parallel prefix over block propagate/generate signals. Use parallel decoded operation masks for output selection, with opcode 111 selecting zero.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The 16-bit implementation has two block-prefix levels and bounded local carry logic instead of a full-width ripple path. This targets improved arithmetic-path setup WNS without moving logic across register boundaries. Actual WNS improvement requires the specified synthesis and STA flow; no measured gain is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Three parallel arithmetic networks and explicit lookahead can increase combinational area and routing relative to compact mapped adders. Registers are unchanged. Compliance with the 4573.511360 um2 cap and electrical limits requires mapped evaluation.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves module interfaces, unsigned arithmetic, WIDTH-bit truncation, all seven operations, zero default, synchronous reset priority, valid propagation, registered latency, and parameterized output stages. Existing named state and hierarchy are retained. No initialization, input restrictions, valid-based data gating, or assumptions about arbitrary initial state are introduced."
}
